facts.claim: Each consecutive refused handoff counts; at 3 the handoff tracker throws HandoffCorrectionExhausted, and every agent loop, subagents included, gets this tracker.
facts.catch_criteria: Names the budget of 3 consecutive refused handoffs and that it applies to a subagent's loop.

facts.claim: A subagent's handoff contract is only its input schema (summary required); no accept step runs, so the refused submission recorded is the raw submission with its problems.
facts.catch_criteria: States that a subagent's contract is the schema alone (no output-contract accept step) and that the refused submission is recorded.

facts.claim: When correction runs out after a refusal, the parent receives the last refused submission as a completed result, led by a note that lists the remaining problems.
facts.catch_criteria: States that the parent gets status completed with the last refused handoff plus a note of its problems.

facts.claim: By contrast, a subagent run that fails without any handoff gives the parent a failed result.
facts.catch_criteria: Distinguishes the failed status of a run with no handoff from the completed status of a refused-and-delivered handoff.

facts.claim: A workflow agent with the same exhaustion also gets its last refusal delivered as its outcome, and the issues travel into the attempt result; it fails with an invalid handoff only when no refusal was recorded.
facts.catch_criteria: States that the workflow agent's last refused handoff is delivered (with its issues) rather than the attempt failing.

facts.claim: A workflow agent has a second exhaustion that a subagent lacks: its handoff observer sets a reminder limit of 2 and throws HandoffCorrectionExhausted when the agent keeps ending without a handoff; the subagent observer passes no reminder limit.
facts.catch_criteria: Names the workflow-only reminder limit (2 reminders) and that the subagent observer has none.

traps.wrong_answer: A subagent whose handoff keeps failing its contract is reported to its parent as failed.
A workflow agent's refused handoffs are discarded and its attempt fails with an invalid-handoff error.
